configuration: Full: embedded SkyUI MCM; Lite: no MCM/SKSE; one ESL-flagged AstralSigil.esp per edition

settings.label: Magic effect brightness
settings.description: Scales the glow of casting effects, projectiles and tracked impact/ground effects. Default: 1.0. Does not change scene lighting or the staff metal.

settings.label: First-person casting size
settings.description: Scales the rune circle and held spear in first person only. Default: 0.8. Does not resize the staff, third-person effect or flying projectile.

settings.label: Casting core and seal glow
settings.description: Adjusts the central light core and central seal of the casting circle. Default: 0.45. Multiplies Magic effect brightness; does not control the entire spear or staff crystal.

settings.label: Ready-state rune size pulse
settings.description: Adds a subtle size pulse to the rune circle while holding a fully charged cast after four seconds. Does not disable glow pulses built into the effect.

settings.label: Final spear compression
settings.description: Adds a brief 12 percent compression of the held spear near the end of the four-second charge. Does not disable crystal assembly or change charge time.

settings.label: Rune-circle kickback
settings.description: Adds a short backward movement of the rune circle when a shot is released. Does not change character recoil, projectile direction or damage.

settings.label: Crystal scatter on cancellation
settings.description: Retired control: partial material-sharing conflict on Cinderfang. Restored to the enabled visual default during menu initialization/update.

settings.label: Embers and ice fragments in flight
settings.description: Retired control: partial material-sharing conflict on Cinderfang. Restored to the enabled visual default during menu initialization/update.

settings.label: Broken tracer arcs
settings.description: ON shows gaps in the tracer rings around the flying projectile. OFF lights the gap pieces for fuller rings. Does not disable all tracer rings.

settings.label: Embers at fire impact
settings.description: Shows small embers in Cinderfang's impact burst. Does not control the flying projectile, ground fire or impact damage.

settings.label: Ground ice crystals
settings.description: Shows the growing crystals in Stormheart's ground residue. Does not control the held spear or crystals on the flying projectile.

settings.label: New ground effect lifetime
settings.description: Lifetime of newly created fire and ice ground effects: 3-8 seconds; default 5. Existing effects keep their own lifetime. Does not change scorch decals or explosion duration.

settings.label: Ice crackle on new ground effects
settings.description: Enables crackling sound on newly created ice ground effects. Changing this does not stop a loop already playing on an existing effect.

settings.label: Ground fire deals damage
settings.description: Adds approximately one damage application per second to hostile living enemies near Cinderfang's ground fire. Excludes the player and companions; overlapping patches do not stack this extra hit. OFF by default.

settings.label: Ground fire damage per tick
settings.description: Base damage for each ground-fire tick, approximately once per second. Only used when Ground fire deals damage is ON. Default: 3. Actual damage depends on game effect processing and resistances.

settings.label: Transform weapon
settings.description: Keyboard key for switching a drawn Stormheart or Cinderfang between staff and mace. Default: G. Unmap to disable. Unavailable while casting, attacking, in menus or other blocked states.
